description: Construction number 3H-1629; the tactical number 1629 derives from it. Unveiled 15 August 2023 at the corner of ul. Krucza and ul. Armii Krajowej as part of Filip Idzikowski's "Niebo bez granic" project. PAINTED AS "5" IN THE COLOURS OF A FICTITIOUS "Biało-Czerwona Iskra" DISPLAY TEAM — the number 5 it wears is not its identity. Commemorates majors Tomasz Pajórek and Mariusz Oliwa killed 11 November 1998
